body.text: Beau Lamarre-Condon murder trial live: Cross-examination continues for accused in court
Cross-examination by the Crown prosecutor is continuing in the NSW Supreme Court.
Former police officer Beau Lamarre-Condon is accused of murdering Jesse Baird and Luke Davies in February 2024. He has pleaded not guilty.
Follow our live coverage here.

Hatfield asks if Lamarre-Condon posted Baird on his socials to "ward off the competition".

"We were romantically seeing each other and this point it wasn't a casual thing," he says. "In January before Jesse went overseas, it was definitely frequently too."

Tense scenes on Monday
It has been at times tense between Lamarre-Condon and Hatfield, as the Crown prosecutor presses him on his version of events.
The accused on Tuesday was argumentative as Hatfield suggested he was lying on certain recollections and influencing a witness.
He rebutted by saying vital people hadn't been brought before the court, and claimed the jury hadn't been shown key moments in evidence.
At other points, Lamarre-Condon would tear up and become emotional as he spoke about suicide attempts and Jesse Baird's death.
